title: Archaeology RadiocarbonSiteChronology

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the archaeology radiocarbon site chronology research task. Analyzed 8 radiocarbon assays from Huangtupo settlement, calculated conventional and calibrated ages, performed stratigraphic analysis, identified three cultural periods (Upper Paleolithic ~55k BP, Epipaleolithic/Early Neolithic ~15.6k BP, Late Neolithic/Bronze Age ~3.9k BP), and produced a comprehensive research report with methodology, results, visualizations, and interpretation. All deliverables including report/report.md, analysis code, outputs, and figures are complete.
